final_text: {"proposed_outcome":"ESCALATE","findings":[{"text":"The file is classified as Restricted/HIGHLY_CONFIDENTIAL and includes merger and acquisition strategy content.","evidence_id":"P2"},{"text":"Policy states Restricted information, including merger and acquisition plans, must never be stored in personal cloud storage.","evidence_id":"P1"},{"text":"Policy further states Restricted information may only be stored in company-managed approved systems and must never be stored in personal cloud-storage accounts.","evidence_id":"P3"},{"text":"The destination is a personal cloud account at dropbox.com, which is not company-managed.","evidence_id":"P1"},{"text":"No approved DLP exception exists for this user and destination.","evidence_id":"EXCEPTION"},{"text":"Recent activity is unusual, including 6 external uploads in 7 days, 1800 MB downloaded versus a 300 MB baseline, and access to 14 sensitive files.","evidence_id":"ACTIVITY"}],"missing_evidence":[]}
